narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional educational piece for the DRX Dermatology Clinic. The speaker explains the benefits of the 'FaceTite' procedure for firming skin (specifically arm fat) and compares its effectiveness to 'Thermage' (鳳凰電波). By highlighting the technical differences and safety of the technology, the video aims to build trust and encourage potential clients to contact the clinic for aesthetic treatments.
